"''There!|Rex and Ahsoka Tano|}} A '''BTL-B Y-wing fighter-bomber''' was utilized by the [[Galactic Republic]] near the end of the [[Clone Wars]]. The [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber]] was aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tribunal]]'' when [[Order 66]] was issued, which caused the [[clone trooper]]s onboard to [[Skirmish aboard the Tribunal|turn]] against former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]]. After Tano had freed [[Clone Commander]] [[Rex]] from his [[Behavioral modification biochip|inhibitor chip]], the two attempted to escape the ''Tribunal'', which had fallen into a collision course with a [[Unidentified moon|moon]] after [[Maul|Darth Maul]], a former [[prisoner]] on the [[starship]], destroyed its [[hyperdrive]]. Maul stole the [[shuttle]] Tano and Rex had intended to take, and the two found the [[starfighter]] in the repair bay at the last minute as enemy clones fired on them, effecting a narrow and dangerous escape. After the Republic was [[Proclamation of the New Order|reformed]] into the [[Galactic Empire]], Rex continued to utilize the Y-wing as he sought to fight back against the new regime. When he met the former [[clone commando]]s of the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]] on the junk [[planet]] [[Bracca]] so that they could use the medical facilities of a wrecked [[Unidentified Venator-class Star Destroyer (Clone Force 99)|Star Destroyer]] to remove the Batch's inhibitor chips, Rex landed the Y-wing inside the remains of another vessel. When the Bad Batch arrived, they landed their [[transport]], the [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']], beside the Y-wing, disembarking to follow Rex to their destination. ==Description== As a [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber]], the [[starfighter]] was equipped with two [[ion jet engine]]s for propulsion. Its armament consisted of two front-mounted [[laser cannon]]s and a rotatable [[SW-4 ion cannon]]{{BuildFalconCite|19|Starship Fact File}} controlled from the [[gunner]]'s turret. The ship had extendable legs for landing on the ground. 23.4 [[meter]]s in length, the [[bomber]] could carry three crew members: a [[pilot]] in its [[cockpit]], a gunner in the central bubble turret, and an [[astromech droid]] in the onboard [[Astromech socket|socket]], situated to the rear of the gunner's turret. Accessible by a three-paned hatch, the cockpit contained controls to activate the starfighter's [[engine]]s and to open the gunner's turret. The Y-wing had a largely [[Color|white]] paint job, with blue stripes on its central body and grey markings down the length of the engines, which were also marked with the [[Republic crest]] in black. ==History== ===Order 66=== The Y-wing was utilized by the [[Republic Navy|Galactic Republic Navy]] late in the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' the Y-wing was part of the onboard complement of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tribunal]]''''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' when it was present above{{TCW|Shattered}} the [[planet]] [[Mandalore]] shortly after the end of the recent [[Siege of Mandalore|siege]], in which the [[Mandalore resistance]] and [[332nd Division|forces]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] had defeated the [[Shadow Collective]] and captured its leader, the rogue [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]]. The ''Tribunal'', under the command of former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Clone Commander]] [[Rex]], was to deliver Maul to the [[Jedi High Council]] on [[Coruscant]]. At the time, the Y-wing was docked in the ''Tribunal''{{'s}} repair bay above an exit in the [[capital ship]]'s bottom [[hull]], and was the only ship in the repair bay not currently undergoing maintenance. However, shortly after the ''Tribunal'' jumped into [[hyperspace]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]] issued [[Order 66]], a command which compelled the [[clone trooper]]s of the Grand [[Army]] to turn on and [[Death penalty|execute]] their [[Jedi General]]s through [[Behavioral modification biochip|inhibitor chips]] implanted in their [[brain]]s. Tano was [[Skirmish aboard the Tribunal|forced]] to go on the run onboard the ship, releasing Maul from the detention level as a distraction before freeing Rex from the brainwashing with the help of three astromech [[droid]]s, including her old unit [[R7-A7]]. Once Rex's chip had been removed, he and Tano attempted to escape the [[Star Destroyer]]. However, the [[escape pod]]s had been destroyed because of orders Rex had given while he was brainwashed, so they were forced to head for the [[hangar]], hoping to steal a [[shuttle]]. Maul, left to his own devices, destroyed the ''Tribunal''{{'s}} [[hyperdrive]], setting the [[cruiser]] out of hyperspace and onto a collision course with a [[Unidentified moon|moon]]. When Tano and Rex reached the hangar control room, they discovered both that the starship was doomed and that the clone troopers, led by [[Clone Lieutenant]] [[Advanced Recon Commando|ARC trooper]] [[Jesse|CT-5597]] "Jesse", had assembled in the hangar to try and prevent any escapes. Noticing that Jesse and his men were standing atop the lifts to the repair bay, Tano concocted a plan to make it easier for her and Rex to reach the shuttle by sending most of the clones to the maintenance level. However, while Tano and Rex were fighting off the remaining clones in the hangar, Maul entered and stole the [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class attack/transport shuttle]] in [[bay 12]] that they had intended to take. Tano was unable to prevent Maul from escaping, being forced to let him go as Rex was in danger of being overwhelmed by clone reinforcements that had arrived. She cut a hole in the floor to bring herself and Rex down to the repair bay, with droids [[RG-G1]] and [[CH-33P]] launching the lifts back up before the clones destroyed them. [[File:EscapeTribunalVD.png|thumb|right|250px|Tano and Rex fight near the Y-wing.]] Tano and Rex attempted to find another ship to escape in, but discovered that almost all of the ships in the repair bay were under maintenance and thus unflyable. After taking out some clones that remained in the bay, Tano spotted the Y-wing in its docking port and pointed it out to Rex. They repelled some more clones before running towards the starfighter, but the lifts began to descend as Jesse's forces had gained control of them. As Tano began to defend herself against their [[blaster]] fire, Rex continued running towards the Y-wing, shouting for Tano to get him over to the ship. When he reached the edge of the hole, Tano [[Force push]]ed him across the gap and onto the fighter, where he managed to get a grip on it as Tano turned her attention back to the clones' fire. Climbing onto the bomber, Rex [[stun]]ned a few of the attacking clones before opening the cockpit hatch and getting inside. At that point, the ''Tribunal'' had entered the [[moon]]'s [[atmosphere]], and the command [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] exploded, killing the bridge officers and setting the capital ship completely out of control. The clones and Tano lost their footing, and Rex, seeing the situation, took the pilot's seat and shouted for Tano to get over to the Y-wing. Tano leapt for the starfighter, but it was knocked free of its mooring and blown into the trail of debris flowing behind the doomed Star Destroyer, leaving Tano in freefall. Rex managed to activate the Y-wing after a brief struggle, getting it under control and flying it back towards the ''Tribunal''. He looked around for Tano, opening the gunner's hatch when he finally found her. Tano grabbed the hatch, but lost her grip and was set flying again. As Rex followed her in the fighter, she slowed herself down by running along one of the ''Tribunal''{{'s}} dislodged [[ion engine]]s, and was able to successfully board the Y-wing after leaping off of it. Rex maneuvered the starfighter away from the ongoing crash, and he and Tano watched the ''Tribunal'' sink beneath the [[cloud]]s. Tano and Rex landed the Y-wing at the crash site, where they salvaged the remains of R7-A7 and other useful items, as well as [[Burial|burying]] the dead, as no one onboard the ''Tribunal'' had survived. As Tano spent a final moment at the graveyard, Rex walked back to the fighter and stowed a shovel he had used in a rack on its side, before turning back to look at Tano. ===Imperial Era=== {{Quote|Where's your ship?''"
"''By the river.|Bail Organa and Ahsoka Tano|{{TOTJ|Resolve (episode)}}}} After leaving the moon, Tano discovered that her friend, [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], had died. Tano and Rex travelled to Amidala's [[homeworld]] of [[Naboo]]{{Film|III}} so Tano could attend her [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|funeral]]. Landing the starfighter in a [[Water|river]] valley near the [[city]] of [[Theed]], Rex stayed with the ship while Tano was gone. At the funeral, Tano was spotted by [[Alderaanian]] Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]], who was surprised that she had come despite the danger. When Organa asked her where her ship was, she told him it was by the river. Organa gave Tano a [[comlink]] to contact him with before the two parted ways, Tano evading [[Imperial shock trooper|shock trooper]] patrols before descending back into the valley and returning to the ship, whereupon she and Rex left Naboo. Tano and Rex parted ways to go into hiding from the new [[Galactic Empire]],[[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']] the repaired R7 winding up with [[Trace Martez|Trace]] and [[Rafa Martez]],{{TBB|Decommissioned}} two sisters Tano had met after leaving the [[Jedi Order]].{{TCW|Gone with a Trace}} Rex kept the Y-wing, and began working against the Empire. With the sisters' help, Rex tracked down [[Clone Force 99]], a unit of rogue clones who had been immune to their inhibitor chips, and had them meet him on the junk planet [[Bracca]] to surgically remove them in a [[Unidentified Venator-class Star Destroyer (Clone Force 99)|wrecked Venator]]. He landed the Y-wing in a wrecked hangar near the target ship's location in Bracca's starship graveyard, with the "Bad Batch" landing their shuttle [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']] next to the starfighter when they arrived. After the surgeries were performed, Rex parted ways with the [[squad]] as he had to make a rendezvous with a contact. ==Owners and operators== After the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the Galactic Empire, the Y-wing was owned and used by [[Captain]] Rex. ==Behind the scenes== The Y-wing first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' series finale "[[Victory and Death]]." ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Victory and Death}} {{1st}} *{{TOTJ|Resolve (episode)}} *{{TBB|Battle Scars}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/victory-and-death-episode-guide|text="Victory and Death" Episode Guide - The Clone Wars}} *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/battle-scars-episode-guide|text="Battle Scars" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} {{Po}} *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/extraction-episode-guide|text="Extraction" Episode Guide | Star Wars: The Bad Batch}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Caza estelar/bombardero BTL-B Ala-Y de Rex |fr=Y-Wing BTL-B de Rex |ka=რექსის Y-ფრთებიანი ვარსკვლავური გამანადგურებელი-ბომბდამშენი BTL-B |tr=Rex'in BTL-B Y-wing savaşçı-bombacısı }} [[Category:BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] [[Category:Starships of the Galactic Republic]]
